description: Start here for any Usercase work — whether the user typed a command or just asked in their own words. Returns the step-by-step procedure; follow it as the user's request, and call this before the other Usercase tools. Commands: research (test or get feedback on the site with virtual users; `research` id to have them take part in a research), new-research (plan or create a research / usability study), install (add or install the Usercase script on the site), question (make a question to ask visitors at a moment on the site), steps (write the steps for the question open in the dashboard; `session` = its window id), path (record the expected paths of a research's tasks; `research` id, optional `task`), fix (fix a finding from a research report: `research` id + `finding` key like F1, `audience` real for the real-people report; or an issue from Issues: `issue` id), connect (connect this repository to another Usercase project).

count.description: How many people (default 5), or "unlimited" to keep going until you stop it

focus.description: Only people who come for this part of the site, e.g. calendar, or comments and sharing

issue.description: An issue id from the dashboard's Issues — fixes that issue instead of a report finding

research.description: The research id, or its name as the user said it (the server finds it by name; if several or none match, it lists them — ask the user which one)

session.description: The window id shown in the dashboard command

name: instructions
